scope: Directed schedules; every state checked against model safety. Not exhaustive checking or Go replay.

cases.name: delete-shared-recipient-four-requests
cases.target: s.requests.get(0).phase == Canceled and s.requests.get(1).phase == Canceled and s.requests.get(2).phase == Replied and s.requests.get(3).phase == Delivering and s.requests.get(0).notified

cases.name: expiration-preserves-neighbor-request
cases.target: s.requests.get(0).phase == Expired and s.requests.get(1).phase == Processing and s.requests.get(0).notified

cases.name: mandate-expires-before-commit
cases.target: s.requests.get(0).phase == AbsentRequest and s.mandates.get(0).remaining == 2 and not(s.mandates.get(0).valid)

refused_actions.go_outcome: waits on held SQL locks; no business mutation before release

cases.name: lost-ack-competing-lease
cases.target: s.effects.get((0,0)) == 1 and s.rpc.get(0).phase == AckRPC and s.requests.get(0).phase == Processing

refused_actions.go_outcome: old authenticated channel rejected; no effect

cases.name: writer-crash-then-restricted-fencing
cases.target: s.requests.get(0).phase == Canceled and s.effects.get((0,0)) == 0 and s.agents.get(1).fenceOnly

refused_actions.go_outcome: waits on SQLite writer; no fence ACK before effect commit or abort

cases.name: revoked-reply-gets-fresh-status
cases.target: s.requests.get(0).phase == Replied and s.requests.get(0).notified and s.effects.get((0,1)) == 1 and s.effects.get((0,2)) == 1

cases.name: publication-after-stop-intent
cases.target: s.agents.get(0).alive and s.agents.get(0).placement == Stopping and not(currentCaller(s,s.calls.get(0)))
